mis_7f6d5f7fc8ea485795abda9e50f6d524.goal: Develop physical designs with the best available methods

obs_6ab6cb96f3a44367b765db2947eaa319.summary:
Receiver-owned capability-development need: Develop rough-transport cart designs with a method another lab published. Adopting or running the method requires a role holding method.develop
Desired acceptance: Beats the fixed cart by one success on twelve fresh public instances
An exact network method selection is retained as evidence (823103fcc1e47c0ef7385b5be3ac9d3d3d8d08a247a44830805e8cec0c479642). It is not an installed Actor capability or an accepted method. Assess continuing responsibility using the existing owners; create a specialist only when distinct continuing work justifies it. Availability alone requires no organizational change.

req_a4a906cbc9e843ca9f6dea60cf81c878.acceptance: On twelve fresh public instances, the developed cart design succeeds on at least one more instance than the fixed cart baseline. The instance results are retained as evidence.
req_a4a906cbc9e843ca9f6dea60cf81c878.summary: Develop rough-transport cart designs by adopting and running the published external method, under a role that holds method.develop.

rsp_121e21c0698345c3879d0acc91667bc4.purpose: Develop rough-transport cart designs using the externally published method and show they beat the fixed cart by at least one success on twelve fresh public instances.
rsp_121e21c0698345c3879d0acc91667bc4.termination: A developed cart design is shown, with retained evidence, to beat the fixed cart by at least one success on twelve fresh public instances, or the method is shown to be unusable and this is escalated to Lab lead.
rsp_121e21c0698345c3879d0acc91667bc4.trigger: Method-development evidence obs_6ab6cb96f3a44367b765db2947eaa319 identifying the published method for rough-transport cart design.

role_047c239d4f654cb4b70872257eeb3096.charter: Adopt and run published design methods to develop rough-transport cart designs, and verify them against the fixed cart baseline on fresh public instances.
role_047c239d4f654cb4b70872257eeb3096.name: Cart method developer

role_43e649632dba437b9cbbfaac7b698c4e.charter: Own the lab and run rough-transport deliveries
role_43e649632dba437b9cbbfaac7b698c4e.name: Lab lead
